$comment: pcbjam static gallery, curated down to the single Protogon board. `root` is resolved relative to the pcbjam checkout root (that is where build-dist.sh runs publish-content, after staging the board + custom models into .gallery-src/codemyriad-protogon/). Each files[] path doubles as the in-browser MEMFS path, so the custom 3D models MUST be listed as packages3d/<name>.step to match the board's relative (model ...) refs.
